units.rawText: Professor, have you ever been trained in swordsmanship?

spans.text: Professor, have you ever been trained in swordsmanship?

units.rawText: It takes more than just speed and strength to be a competent swordsman. The key is to become one with your sword. You have to see the sword as a part of you, an extension of your body, and not just a tool.
